description: This is a test class 'ImmutableConnectionPlaceholderTest' for the 'ImmutableConnectionIdPlaceholder' class. It contains unit tests verifying placeholder functionalities such as prefix retrieval, supported names, support for specific placeholders, and resolution logic using ConnectionId objects.

methods.name: getSupportedNames
methods.description: Tests that getSupportedNames() returns a list containing 'id'.

methods.description: Verifies that each supported placeholder returns true for supports().
